dict.string: HashNotch asks your media apps for the current track and artwork — and, for web videos, asks your browser for the playing tab's address to show its thumbnail — so Now Playing can appear around the notch. Playback and volume are controlled only when you use the panel's buttons. Deny this and everything else still works.

HashNotch reads the names and dates of files in your Downloads folder so it can show a short notice at the notch when a download finishes. It never opens, moves, or uploads a file. Deny this and everything else still works.
